title: RAW UNREGISTERED: same-pivot suffix exchange tests whether complete prefixes and suffixes retain partner dependence beyond every observable one-step transition table
owner: Root owns registration/selection; positive_constraints_review drafted source-free mathematics

mechanism.human_simple_hypothesis: At a declared checkpoint in a word, the writer can choose the remaining complete tail knowing only the checkpoint sign and the fixed pool context, without remembering the exact earlier prefix. This is an observable-state independence hypothesis, not proof of a actual scribal checkpoint or linguistic boundary.
mechanism.null_factorization: Within one pool, p(L,R|context)=a(L|context)*b(R|context), with positive support on the retained prefix and suffix margins. Prefixes include the shared pivot sign; suffixes start immediately after it. Separate word occurrences are exchangeable under this law. No word-specific hidden topic/state, time drift, or joint readability selection is implicitly allowed.
mechanism.alternative: The actual left/right pairing receives extra weight not factorizing into independent prefix and suffix terms. This could reflect lexical construction, latent mixture membership, unobserved context or other selection; it does not uniquely identify memory or meaning.

fixed_scope.cut: For unit length n, k=floor(n/2), L=w[:k], R=w[k:], pivot=L[-1]. The midpoint is fixed to reuse an explicit existing convention, not selected as a native morpheme boundary. No alternate-cut search.
pool_key: exact pivot unit at position k-1

exact_invariance_proof.position_edges: Every edge before the cut stays with its original prefix. Every edge strictly after the cut stays with its original suffix at the same absolute ordinal. The cut edge is pivot -> first(R_j); the pivot is identical for every carrier, so it too stays equivalent to the donor original edge. Therefore the aggregate count of EVERY(position,previousunit,nextunit) triple is exactly unchanged within the pool. First-unit counts and fixed last units are also retained.
exact_invariance_proof.arbitrary_Markov1: Let P(w)=P0(w0|c,n,page)*product_i T_i(w_i|w_(i-1),c,n,page), allowing arbitrary position/length/page-specific transition tables. The total product over all reassigned words is unchanged because its complete sufficient statistics are unchanged. Equivalently P(L_i R_j)=a_i b_j and every permutation has product(product_i a_i)(product_j b_j). Tables need not equal frozen1279/1308 estimates. If observed margins have positive mass, recombination introduces no new unseen local transition under these contexts.
exact_invariance_proof.conditional_law: After conditioning on both occurrence bags and the fixed pool context, every labelled donor permutation is equally likely under the factorized null. Duplicate strings retain labelled multiplicity; no estimated Markov probabilities or MCMC are needed for the reference.
exact_invariance_proof.what_is_not_preserved: Each individual word may acquire different bigram counts, full class mask, identity and lexical frequency. The theorem preserves their aggregate position-specific edge counts, not GDT1280individual-word invariants.
exact_invariance_proof.H_vs_mixture: The un-mixed1316H has H(L,R)=P_H(L|Currier,n)*P_H(R|Currier,n,pivot), so it factorizes on these pools where its margins have positive support. This does NOT imply that MIX_H=(M1+H)/2 factorizes: a mixture of two products is generally not a product. The experiment neither uses an H>0filter nor scores/refits H. FrozenHzero-support cases must not be silently claimed to have a defined Hconditional distribution.
exact_invariance_proof.mixture_counterexample: Two equally weighted independent binary joint laws with marginal probabilities(0.9,0.9) and(0.1,0.1) yield mixture cell masses0.41,0.09,0.09,0.41. Pairing products0.41^2 and0.09^2 differ. Thus a latent per-word component can create coupling without an explicit learned whole-word lexicon.

fixed_score.name: Unchanged1308MIX_Q versus M1 log-ratio, used only as an association score
fixed_score.models: P is frozen1308position-aware M1. Q is its frozen exact whole-form TRAIN frequency within Currier/length. M=(P+Q)/2 if the TRAINcell is nonempty, otherwise M=P. No new fit, smoothing, mixture tuning, Hscore or novel-only filter.
fixed_score.matrix: For every pair i,j compute S_ij=log(M(L_i R_j)/P(L_i R_j)) using stable arithmetic. P and M are positive on all strings. The sum of logP is constant over assignments by the theorem; this score therefore tests complete-form weighting after retaining every declared local transition factor.
fixed_score.expectation: Observed O=sum_i S_ii. Exact uniform expectation E=sum_i(sum_j S_ij/N). A pool is score-mobile iff an anchored rectangle S_ij+S_00-S_i0-S_0j differs from0by more than1e-12; save first row-major witness.
fixed_score.interpretation: O-E is an excess score in nats, not the normalized conditional predictive loglikelihood gain of1375. Do NOT call it a translation probability or subtract it from1375as a share explained. No permanent normalizer is required for this declared association endpoint.
